name: Cult banner
description: A tattered dark wine-red cloth banner on a tall iron pole, about 1 m wide and 2.5 m high: it hangs from an iron crossbar under a spiked finial, its lower edge torn into ragged tails, a pale sigil of a ring round a five-pointed star painted on its front, and the pole stands in a heavy cross-shaped iron foot.
